svg.aria-label: A benchmark run with 30,000 chance chimeras gives 12,314 positions where foreign reads cluster. 3,645 of them have 3 or more supporting reads, and 6 of those have as much support as the weakest real insertion, so read count alone cannot separate them. 19 survive the test against chance chimeras and every one is a real insertion. The low-support cloud is drawn as a random sample.
svg.text: position along 10 Mb of host genome

g.text: 6 of them carry as much support as the weakest real insertion, so counting reads cannot separate them
19 survive the test against chance chimeras
every one of them is a real insertion
